email.body1:
David, saw Axos Bank join Qualia's Bank Partner Network to expand digital closings.

Network growth like that usually surfaces more in-market title and escrow accounts than a core team can personally cover, and uncovered accounts are where quota quietly slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Qualia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for Qualia.

As the partner network grows, the pipeline target usually expands faster than you can staff for. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Qualia needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to other proptech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Onboarding new bank partners is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a title-and-escrow motion? I will tailor it to Qualia either way.
